title: Propagate the 2026-09-04 unpinned-approval ruling into the governed surfaces: the enqueue hook, its self-test (RED in CI), AGENTS.md and the PM skill
body:
Found by the `os-dev` seat while implementing #15187 (guard half in PR #15203). Not filed as a drive-by: it is the half of that ruling which lands in **governed** files, and PR #15203 cannot go green without it.

The 2026-09-04 maintainer ruling — verbatim and untranslated — 「你的门禁有问题，只需要有人工批准记录就行，不需要卡最新的提交。」 — retires the sha pin on the governed merge-queue approval predicate. #15203 lands that in `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`. Four governed surfaces still state the retired rule, and one of them is a CI gate that now reds.

## 1. `.claude/hooks/guard-governed-enqueue.selftest.sh` — RED in CI today

`lint.yml` discovers and runs every `.claude/hooks/*.selftest.sh` as the job **Claude hook guard self-tests**. Two of its cases pin the retired pin:

```
FAIL want=block got=allow  a STALE approval (approved an earlier head) never counts
FAIL missing "STALE approval"  a stale approval is reported as stale, not as absent
```

Measured by ablation on the branch of PR #15203 — the pre-ruling guard restored on disk, hook self-test re-run, then restored from HEAD:

| tree | hook self-test |
|:---|:---|
| pre-ruling guard | 49 passed, 0 failed |
| with the ruling | 47 passed, 2 failed |

Both cases must flip direction: an authorised approval on an earlier head now ALLOWS.

## 2. `.claude/hooks/guard-governed-enqueue.sh` — wrong advice, and the deferred rename

Its runtime verdict is already correct without any edit — it imports the predicate, so it inherits the ruling (measured: an authorised approval on an older commit now returns `state: approved`, and the hook exits 0). Two things still need the edit:

- The blocking message tells a seat: "A push after the approval unpins it — re-request, do not re-enqueue." That is now false and sends seats to do work the gate no longer asks for. The surrounding lines ("no APPROVED review pinned to its current head", "Wait for the APPROVED review to land on THIS head sha") are wrong in the same way.
- The symbol `pinnedApprovalVerdict` names something it no longer does. PR #15203 deliberately keeps the name, because this hook imports it and a rename there alone would break a seat-side guard into silent fail-open. The rename belongs in the same commit as this hook's call site — `authorizedApprovalVerdict` matches the file's own `unauthorizedApprovers` spelling. `staleApprovers` is retained by that PR as a printed reading (authorised approvals given on a commit that is no longer the head, which now also count), so this hook's detail line stays valid but becomes unreachable on the blocking path.

## 3. `AGENTS.md` — the governed-landing paragraph

Still reads: "Those four lift only for an authorized approval pinned to the current head (2026-08-27; guard 2026-08-28): APPROVED, by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` …, `commit_id` = that sha … and any later push expires it." The approver set half stands; the pin half and "any later push expires it" do not.

## 4. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`

Still reads: 「APPROVED 且 `commit_id` = PR 当前 head 才算,批准后再推提交即过期转红」. Same correction. This one matters twice over: it is the text every later PM dispatch reads, so a stale rule there propagates into work nobody has started yet.

## Landing note

All four paths are governed (`.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`), so a PR carrying them is a governed-surface PR: no seat flips it ready, enqueues it or arms auto-merge. It needs the maintainer's own merge, or one authorised approval — which, once #15203 lands, no longer expires on a later push.

⚠️ Ordering: this and PR #15203 have to land together or this one first. #15203 alone leaves **Claude hook guard self-tests** red on `main`.
